game_class: finite two-round imperfect-information game with simultaneous ballots and an acyclic continuation graph

nature_and_information.persistence: theta is drawn before formation and persists through both rounds
nature_and_information.common_knowledge: the prior and every game primitive in this contract are common knowledge

primitive_domain.recognition: pi_H=0 in both rounds; exactly one weak proposer is drawn uniformly in every reached round, and the draw is independent across rounds and independent of theta and public history

institutional_rule.post_optout_quota: the original quota is retained; it is not recalculated

formation.timing: after Nature draws theta and before Round-1 recognition
formation.decision: the weak states make one collective all-or-nothing decision without observing theta
formation.cost: each weak state pays external sunk cost chi if the institution forms
formation.nonformation_payoffs: each weak state receives 0 and H receives o_theta
formation.assessment_index: alpha indexes a complete equilibrium assessment or authorized selection from the downstream payoff correspondence
formation.formation_rule: form if and only if V_W^R(alpha,mu)-chi>=0; equality forms
formation.correspondence_rule: when bargaining payoffs are a correspondence, entry is evaluated assessment by assessment; payoff bounds support only selection-free claims and never choose an assessment

proposal_space.active_H: a recognized weak proposer i chooses s_i=(y,(x_j)_{j!=i}) with 0<=y<=y_bar and x_j>=0
proposal_space.weak_only: after H has opted out the proposal fixes y=0 and allocates the unit weak surplus
proposal_space.named_payment_rule: a named x_j is paid whenever the current proposal passes even if recipient j voted no
proposal_space.participation_payment_rule: y is paid only when the current agreement includes H; otherwise it is reabsorbed by the weak proposer

ballot.proposer_vote: the proposer is counted as yes
ballot.nonproposer_moves: all active nonproposers vote yes or no simultaneously
ballot.observations_before_vote: public history and current proposal only; H additionally observes theta
ballot.publication: the complete vote vector and outcome become public only after every vote is cast
ballot.behavioral_randomization: in the absence of an authorized correlating device, behavioral randomizations are independent conditional on the player's information set; no proof may insert correlation among simultaneous ballots

hegemon_optout.effect: immediate and irreversible exclusion from every current or future agreement
hegemon_optout.R1_payoff: o_theta at the Round-1 date with no discount
hegemon_optout.yes_weak_failure: if H votes yes and weak votes cause Round-1 failure then H remains active and the appropriate active-H Round-2 continuation is reached

terminal_failure.active_H_R2: H receives o_theta in Round-2 units and every weak state receives 0
terminal_failure.post_optout_R2: weak states receive 0; H receives no new flow because its Round-1 outside payoff was already realized

payoff_dates_and_discount.native_R2_units: all Round-2 decision problems are solved without beta
payoff_dates_and_discount.transport_to_R1: multiply a frozen Round-2 continuation by beta exactly once when it enters a Round-1 incentive calculation
payoff_dates_and_discount.immediate_R1_optout: o_theta is not multiplied by beta

beliefs.public_history: beliefs are indexed by the full public history and current proposal
beliefs.bayes: update by Bayes rule at every information set reached with positive probability
beliefs.zero_probability: off-path beliefs are assessment components and must be stated rather than chosen inside a proof
beliefs.uninformed_vote: a unilateral vote by a weak state is not treated as direct information about theta
beliefs.type_relevance_after_optout: theta is payoff-irrelevant to a weak-only continuation after H has opted out

vote_relevance.outcome_map: Phi maps an action profile to the induced terminal outcome or to the continuation outcome/interface kappa_C2(h2) under the frozen assessment; a raw successor label or raw vote vector is never itself the continuation component
vote_relevance.relevant_profile: conditional on voter i's information set I, a profile (theta,a_-i) is relevant exactly when changing i's vote changes at least one component of Phi after action-specific continuation interfaces are evaluated
vote_relevance.same_continuation_class: in R1, if both votes reach the same named C2 class but produce different full histories h2, compare kappa_C2(h2_yes) with kappa_C2(h2_no); equal raw node labels do not establish irrelevance
vote_relevance.incentive_difference: sum Pr(theta,a_-i|I) times [u_i(yes)-u_i(no)] only over relevant profiles; every omitted profile contributes exactly zero
vote_relevance.response_when_relevance_has_positive_pro: choose yes when its expected payoff is at least the expected payoff from no; choose no otherwise
vote_relevance.equality_when_relevant: choose yes when the two expected payoffs are equal and relevance has positive probability
vote_relevance.zero_probability_relevance: holding every other strategy fixed, yes and no give the same expected outcome on the current assessment support; the assessment must record an explicit full-profile completion, but no universal player-by-player yes completion is imposed because changing several locally irrelevant actions jointly can change passage
vote_relevance.joint_completion_equivalence: two full assessment-level completions may be quotiented only if they induce the same outcome signature, public-history and belief distribution where relevant, and payoff distribution at every affected proposal and history
vote_relevance.product_safe_warning: individual local irrelevance is not closed under joint changes: with N=4 at terminal unanimity, proposer and H yes, two zero-paid weak no votes are individually irrelevant against the other's no, but changing both to yes passes; the same hazard occurs in N=4 terminal weak-only majority
vote_relevance.completion_invariance_obligation: no substantive result may be promoted until a downstream product-safe proof establishes invariance of outcomes, beliefs, payoffs, proposals, and proposer optimality across the full completions being compared; otherwise retain separate outcome classes or a correspondence

coalitions_and_deviations.primitive_restriction: none beyond feasibility and the institutional quota
coalitions_and_deviations.supporter_payments: payments required for support must be derived from voting incentives
coalitions_and_deviations.outsider_gifts: positive transfers to outsiders remain feasible proposal deviations and stay in proposer optimality checks
coalitions_and_deviations.unrestricted_completion_correspondence: voting completions are proposal-contingent; an on-path proposal and a proposal deviation may have different locally rational full-profile completions
coalitions_and_deviations.general_minimality_result: not available from PBE plus local relevance: positive gifts and oversized support can survive because deleting a gift changes the proposal information set and may change its completion
coalitions_and_deviations.gift_counterexample: in terminal weak-only majority with N=5 and q=3, proposer plus three weak yes votes pass and each weak vote is individually irrelevant; at a deviated zero-gift proposal all three weak no votes also make each unilateral switch irrelevant while the proposal fails
coalitions_and_deviations.open_set_implication: the N=5 finding is not a knife-edge: an open set of feasible positive gift vectors can be paired with the all-yes completion while a distinct deviated proposal receives the all-no completion
coalitions_and_deviations.minimal_winning_representation: may be used only for a subclass after product-safe invariance or secured passage and proposer optimality are proved; otherwise retain unrestricted proposal-contingent completions and their outcome correspondence

proposal_tie_break: only after proposal-payoff maximization, minimize H's expected payoff among tied proposals; if both the proposer and H payoffs tie and downstream objects differ, retain the correspondence
entry_and_comparison_scope: entry nodes consume the frozen Round-1 payoff correspondence or valid selection-free bounds; institutional comparison is restricted to the common equilibrium-existence domain
c2_interface_scope: each C2 object consumed by R1 is a pre-recognition correspondence indexed by the full public h2 and integrates the uniform Round-2 proposer draw; proposer and ballot states are internal to that interface

barrier.gate0: independent read-only review must pass the hash-complete Gate 0 bundle before any Round-2 derivation begins
barrier.R2_to_R1: r2_batch_review must pass after all three Round-2 interfaces are PASS and hash-frozen before either Round-1 node starts
barrier.R1_to_entry: r1_batch_frozen must pass after both Round-1 interfaces are PASS and hash-frozen before either entry node starts
barrier.upstream_change: a changed continuation hash invalidates every descendant interface and review

derivation_status: no Round-2 or Round-1 equilibrium result is contained in this artifact
